editorial:
Imagine being a legendary street fighter who just wants to live a quiet life and take care of his sick mom. That is exactly where you find Gang-cheol in this gritty Busan-based story. He has tried his best to stay out of trouble, but life keeps throwing punches his way. When a guy named Sang-gon offers him a huge amount of money for his fighting skills, it feels like a lifeline. You will quickly see how desperate Gang-cheol is to save his mother, and that makes the whole movie feel personal and intense from the very start.

The action scenes are the real star here, with fights that feel raw and powerful. While the plot is pretty simple, the acting makes you actually care about whether the hero makes it out in one piece. Some parts of the movie drag a bit, but the payoff is worth it. If you are into hard-hitting dramas with a lot of heart, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a huge showdown where Gang-cheol has to face off against the people who manipulated him. After a brutal fight, he manages to take down his enemies and secure the money needed for his mother's surgery. The twist is that he realizes he cannot escape his past by just hiding; he has to fight through it to find peace. In the end, his mother gets the operation, and he finally finds some calm.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves underdog stories and raw fight scenes.
